title: Beholden to neither
odia: ରଜାର ପ୍ରଜା ନୁହେଁ କି ସାହୁର ଖାତକ ନୁହେଁ
literal_meaning: Neither the king’s subject nor the moneylender’s debtor.
explanation: The speaker presents themself as independent and free of debt. It is a forceful refusal to be treated as someone under another’s control.
meaning_odia: କାହାର ଅଧୀନରେ ବା ଋଣରେ ନରହି ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ଭାବରେ ଚଳିବାର ଭାବ ଏଠି ପ୍ରକାଶ ପାଏ।
usage_example: A self-supporting craftsperson rejects a patron’s attempt to dictate a personal decision. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary gloss supports independence and absence of debt. This is figurative self-assertion, not a legal exemption from obligations.
